scope: Local development of an international budget game. No live feed, prices copied from VNL, new club marks or photos. Editorial game costs, not official ratings.
rosterBasis: Existing 14 identities retain 2026–27 league references. Added identities use explicitly labelled 2025 national-team call-ups/World Championship rosters; not a current squad claim.

costModel.method: Independent within-position editorial tiers (development/depth, established, international regular, elite, premium); costs then tested for feasible diverse lineups. Not a mathematical cross-position performance score.
costModel.vnlPriceStatus: No public current player or coach fantasy-price table verified. No VNL fantasy values imported.
costModel.reviewStatus: Initial editorial calibration, subject to user playtest; not a verified ranking.

exclusions: No disputed set-by-set 2025 world final score included. TVF and FIVB disagree on the tie-break score; overall 3-2 agrees.
Brazil name aliases follow official call-up naming; no current club inferred.
Japan Wada/Nonaka roles follow the dated English 2025 national-team call-up (opposite), not a claim about every competition registration.
Old 2026 league event/date caveats remain in the previous provenance manifest.
